learning_outcomes.text: Recognizes functions and some special functions.
Expresses how to take a limit at a point for functions.
Uses the properties of continuous functions.
Compares the physical and geometrical meaning of derivative.

syllabus_topics: Function Concept, Some Special Functions (Power, Polynomial, Absolute Value Functions), Trigonometric and Inverse Trigonometric functions, Exponential, Logarithmic and Hyperbolic Functions
Function Concept, Some Special Functions (Power, Polynomial, Absolute Value Functions), Trigonometric and Inverse Trigonometric functions, Exponential, Logarithmic and Hyperbolic Functions
Limit Concept, Right and Left-Hand Limits, Indeterminate Forms, Limits of Trigonometric Functions
Continuity in Functions, Properties of Continuous Functions (Intermediate Value Theorem, Absolute Max, Min, Local Max, Min definitions)
Higher Order Derivatives, Derivative of Inverse Function, Derivative of Trigonometric Functions
Derivative of Inverse Trigonometric Functions, Derivative of Logarithmic Function, Derivative of Hyperbolic and Inverse Hyperbolic Functions
Derivatives of Functions Given by Parametric Equations, Derivative of Implicit Functions
Geometrical meaning of Derivative, Rolle's Theorem, Mean Value Theorem, Increasing and Decreasing Functions, Concave and Convex Functions, Inflection Points
Maximum and Minimum Concepts, Maximum and Minimum Problems, Taylor's Theorem, Indeterminate Forms (L'Hospital's Rule)
Indeterminate Forms (L'Hospital's Rule) Continued, Concept of Differential
Multivariable Functions and Limit, Continuity and Derivative in Multivariable Functions
Multivariable Functions and Limit, Continuity and Derivative in Multivariable Functions
